Felicia Lewis Group: Carmel Valley's Luxury Home Sale Specialists

Carmel Valley real estate moves fast, and the homes at the top of the market move on details most buyers never see. Felicia Lewis Group was built around that idea, pairing seller representation with a level of preparation and negotiation meant for San Diego's premium neighborhoods.

The team's approach centers on the Signature Seller Concierge program: pricing strategy, targeted marketing, and the Show Perfect™ home preparation process designed to position a property to command its full value before it ever hits the market.

If you're weighing a sale or just want a clear read on what your property is worth right now, the team's home valuation service is built for exactly that conversation.
